title: 15-Minute Veggie Mac and Cheese
subtitle: A quick baked macaroni and cheese packed with broccoli under a buttery, golden crumb.
protein: ~30–35g protein per adult serving — from cheddar, milk and pasta

method.title: Cheese sauce and pasta
items: Preheat the oven to 400°F; grease small baking dishes (2 per batch) and 1 ramekin for the toddler with {@grease} (crème brûlée dishes work great)
Heat a small pot over medium heat; add {@butter} to melt
Add {@flour} and whisk, continuing to whisk over the heat for 1 min
Turn the heat to low and add {@milk} in a slow, steady stream, whisking constantly until thick and smooth
Stir in {@salt}, then {@cheddar} until it melts into the smooth sauce
Turn off the heat and set the cheese sauce aside
Prepare {@pasta} per the package — vent the pouch and microwave only 1 minute
Stir the cooked noodles, {@broccoli} and {@corn} into the cheese sauce

method.label: Toddler — fill her ramekin here (before pepper and chili)
items: Spoon {=½ cup} of the mac and cheese into her ramekin

method.title: Season, top and bake
items: Divide the adult mac and cheese evenly between the baking dishes
Stir {@breadcrumbs}, {@herbs} and {@butter-melted} together in a small bowl; sprinkle over every dish, hers included
Bake about 7–8 min at 400°F, until the tops are golden brown and the cheese is bubbly
Serve immediately — let her ramekin cool a few minutes first

method.label: Tip
method.text: Sriracha → a pinch of Kashmiri chili (sriracha isn't Jain). Seasoned breadcrumbs → plain crumbs + dried herbs, since seasoned ones usually aren't Jain. The carrot in the original veggie mix → sweet corn for the adults; the carrot goes in her ramekin only. No Ready Pasta? Boil 4 oz dry macaroni until just al dente.
